title: Neural Realized Measures: Forecast-Supervised Intraday Aggregation for Volatility Forecasting
idea: Train a small neural network to output positive, mean‑normalized weights for each 5‑minute bar’s realized‑variance contribution (r²) using the daily features available in Volta’s memory (e.g., l_rng, l_iv30, term, gex_rank, time‑of‑day bins). Compute a weighted sum as the daily volatility input to a HAR or MIDAS model and compare next‑day QLIKE against the vanilla equal‑weight realized variance.

title: Neural Realized Measures: Forecast-Supervised Intraday Aggregation for Volatility Forecasting
idea: Train an NRM model on five‑minute NQ index futures price data to predict next‑day 30‑day ATM IV, then compare its QLIKE forecast error to a standard HAR realized variance model; if NRM beats HAR by >5% in out‑of‑sample, use its forecast to size option positions.
